title: God as Root Axiom
axiom: The Trinitarian God is the irreducible root axiom of the framework; all other claims derive from this through formal grammar constrained by physics.
definitions: God: The Trinitarian God, three persons in one being, each constituted through the others, none prior, none derived, none reducible. | Aseity: Existence from Himself; self-grounding. | Perichoresis: Mutual indwelling; the persons ARE their relations. | Love: The ground state of the coupling between the persons. | Physics: The ordered created medium where relation, consequence, choice, time, repair, embodiment, and love can become publicly meaningful. | Grace: God's unmerited favor, entering creation from beyond the closed system. | Agency: The capacity of creatures to choose, including the ability to refuse.
action: The system should treat God as the irreducible root axiom, use the Trinity to ground existence, distinction, relation, and orientation, and interpret physics as the created medium for love and redemption, while maintaining the distinction between physics and grace.
boundary: This axiom does not claim to prove God's existence; it asserts God as the unprovable ground. | It does not equate physics with grace; physics describes conditions, not grace itself. | It does not claim that the analogical mappings are proof; they are declared bridges. | It does not claim that the framework can be fully formalized; it acknowledges partial formalization.
test: Check that all derivations trace back to the God axiom without circularity. | Verify that the four debts (existence, distinction, relation, orientation) are consistently grounded in the Trinity. | Ensure that physics is not used to prove God but as a medium consistent with the axiom. | Test the analogical mappings for internal consistency and note that they are not proofs. | Check that the framework names its own kill conditions and remains falsifiable in principle.
dg1_dependencies: None; this is the root axiom and depends on nothing else.
dg2_new_capability: Provides a single irreducible foundation that grounds existence, distinction, relation, and orientation, and offers a coherent narrative framework for interpreting physics and theology.
dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the requirement that every formal system has an unprovable axiom; it does not attempt to prove God.
dg4_collapse_if_removed: If removed, the entire framework loses its foundational grounding; no other axiom can substitute without changing the system's identity.
dg5_translation_registers: Theology | Physics | Mathematics | Lived reality | Bridge
claim_class: Theological axiom with analogical bridges to physics
recommended_atom_action: Preserve as a foundational axiom; treat analogical mappings as declared bridges, not proofs; require further formalization and adversarial testing.
overstatement_risks: Claiming that physics proves God's character when it only provides analogies. | Treating the necessary ground argument as a proof of God's existence when it is a philosophical argument. | Overstating the convergence of evidence as definitive proof. | Confusing the unprovability of the axiom with evidence for its truth.
kill_conditions: If a physical law is found whose properties do not match any spiritual pattern, the analogical mapping fails. | If the necessary ground argument is shown to be logically invalid. | If the framework claims to prove God's existence, it violates its own axiom.
lean_target: Axiom: God as root; physics as created medium; analogies as declared bridges.
plain_summary: This document establishes God as the single root axiom of the framework, grounding existence, distinction, relation, and orientation through the Trinity. It interprets physics as the created medium for love and redemption, and draws analogies between physical laws and divine attributes. The document explicitly states that these are analogies, not proofs, and that the axiom itself is unprovable. It includes narrative maps and a method for cross-resolution testing. The overall status is coherent as a theological framework, but the scientific and mathematical claims are not established as proofs.

title: THE TRINITY AND TRUTH FOUNDATION
axiom: Truth is first in inquiry; God is first in reality. Truth is of God, not above God. The triadic structure (Being, Expression, Witness) is the structural minimum for truth to be fully real.
definitions: Truth: faithfulness of reality to what is, of speech to reality, of witness to what has been shown, and of God to Himself. | Trinity: one God in three persons (Father, Son, Spirit), distinct but not separate, united in being. | Perichoresis: mutual indwelling of the persons; each fully contains and is contained by the other two. | Aseity: self-existence; God requires no external input. | Simplicity: non-compositeness; God is not composed of parts. | Triadic grammar: Being (Father), Expression (Son), Witness (Spirit) as irreducible roles for truth-bearing manifestation.
action: The system must honor truth as first in inquiry, maintain the triadic grammar in all truth-bearing structures, and test claims in their proper registers (physics, theology, etc.) without smuggling one into another.
boundary: Does not claim physics proves the Trinity; physics discovers triadic grammar, theology names the ground. | Does not claim truth is above God; truth is of God. | Does not claim divine truth is measurable as a quantity. | Does not claim the derivative terms (T.1-T.7) are individually proven; they are proposed awaiting adversarial testing. | Does not claim Instance 5 (Big Bang) is formalized; it is articulated but unformalized. | Does not claim the fruits of the Spirit are formal variables; they are theological source-register descriptors.
test: Check that all claims are tested in the register where they belong (physics, theology, etc.). | Verify that no claim overstates: e.g., 'physics proves the Trinity' is corrected to 'physics discovers triadic grammar'. | Check that the Lean-verified claims (quaternion EM isomorphism, Cross uniqueness) are not extended beyond their formal scope. | Check that open gates (T.4, T.7, Instance 4 holes, Instance 5 unformalized) are acknowledged and not treated as closed. | Check that the triadic grammar is consistently applied without conflating layers.
dg1_dependencies: Lean 4 verified quaternion EM isomorphism (quaternionEM_valid, trinityRelational_valid, heavisideVectorEM_invalid, modalism_invalid). | Lean verified uniqueness of Cross solution (R(offense, alpha) locked). | Historical sources: Augustine, Gregory of Nazianzus, John of Damascus, Athanasius, Boethius, Aquinas. | Physics: Maxwell's equations, Noether's theorem, CPT invariance, Casimir effect, Higgs mechanism. | Mathematics: Gdel, Tarski, Turing incompleteness results.
dg2_new_capability: Provides a unified framework linking truth, Trinity, and triadic structures across physics, information, consciousness, and theology, with a formal Lean-verified core for the Maxwell/Heaviside isomorphism and Cross uniqueness.
dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the distinction between theology and physics; maintains that physics does not prove the Trinity; preserves the historical creeds and patristic sources.
dg4_collapse_if_removed: If the triadic grammar is removed, the framework loses its central explanatory structure for truth and the Trinity; the five instances lose their convergence. If the Lean-verified core is removed, the strongest formal evidence is lost, but the philosophical argument remains.
dg5_translation_registers: Theology register: Trinity, truth, divine attributes. | Physics register: Maxwell's equations, Noether's theorem, CPT, Casimir, Higgs. | Mathematics register: Lean proofs, quaternion algebra, information theory. | Philosophy register: cardinality elimination, self-reference, consciousness.
overstatement_risks: Claiming physics proves the Trinity (corrected in document but may be misread). | Treating derivative terms (T.1-T.7) as proven when they are proposed. | Treating Instance 5 (Big Bang) as formal when it is unformalized. | Treating the triadic necessity as a proof of uniqueness when it is a parsimony argument. | Conflating structural correspondence with derivation.
kill_conditions: If the Lean-verified quaternion EM isomorphism is found to be flawed or not actually verified. | If the Cross uniqueness proof is invalidated. | If the triadic grammar is shown to be insufficient for truth (e.g., a counterexample with n=2 or n=4). | If the open gates (T.4, T.7, Instance 4 holes) are closed in a way that contradicts the framework.

plain_summary: This document establishes a theological framework where truth is first in inquiry and triadic in structure, mapping the Trinity onto truth's necessary roles (Being, Expression, Witness). It presents five instances of triadic necessity, with the strongest formal support from a Lean-verified quaternion EM isomorphism and a Lean-verified uniqueness proof for the Cross. The document explicitly corrects overclaims and acknowledges open gates, making it a coherent but partially formalized framework.

title: The Four Debts and the One Axiom
axiom: The Trinitarian God is the single irreducible ground that pays for the four inquiry debts: existence, distinction, relation, and orientation.
definitions: Existence: something rather than nothing; the primitive that no argument can precede. | Distinction: difference is real; a thing is not its negation; the basis of information (a bit). | Relation: distinguishable things interact lawfully and repeatably; the basis of induction and measurement. | Orientation: some states are better than others; truth beats error, signal beats noise; the basis of value and normativity. | Aseity: God's existence is identical to His essence; He is self-existent. | Perichoresis: mutual indwelling of the divine persons; the ground of lawful relation. | Trinity: one God in three persons, Father, Son, and Holy Spirit; the internal distinctions ground distinction. | Love: the mutual self-gift of the persons; the ground of orientation.
action: The system should adopt the Trinitarian God as the single foundational axiom, and derive all further structure from this axiom, while also maintaining a parallel track that treats the four debts as brute axioms for those who do not accept the theological axiom.
boundary: This axiom does not prove the existence of God; it is posited as an axiom. | It does not claim that the four debts are logically derived from the Trinity in a formal sense; it is a theological move, not a physics derivation. | It does not claim that the fruits of the Spirit are mathematically proved. | It does not claim that the I AM statements are physics constants. | It does not claim that grammar forces saving faith.
test: Check that every derivation step from the four axioms (A1-A4) is valid and does not smuggle in hidden assumptions. | Check that the parallel track (A-sheets) uses no theological vocabulary and survives a reader who rejects all religious claims. | Check that the mapping of the four debts to the Trinity is coherent and does not overstate the formal status. | Check that the document does not overclaim: it must not say consciousness is co-eternal with God, or that the Fruits are fully proved.
dg1_dependencies: The four debts (existence, distinction, relation, orientation) are presupposed by all inquiry. | The parallel track depends on the four axioms being accepted as brute. | The theological track depends on the axiom of the Trinity.
dg2_new_capability: Provides a single axiom that purports to ground the four fundamental presuppositions of inquiry, offering a unified explanation for their coherence.
dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the four debts as inquiry floors; they remain true and necessary even if the theological axiom is rejected.
dg4_collapse_if_removed: If the Trinitarian axiom is removed, the system still functions with the four brute axioms, but loses the explanatory unification and the grounding of the four debts in a single source.
dg5_translation_registers: Theology register: aseity, persons, perichoresis, love. | Science register: existence, distinction, relation, orientation. | Bridge register: the four debts are shared inquiry floors; the Trinity is a candidate ground.
recommended_atom_action: Preserve as a theological axiom and philosophical framework; do not treat as a formal proof.
overstatement_risks: Claiming that the four debts are 'paid' by the Trinity in a formal sense. | Claiming that the elimination funnel proves the Trinity uniquely. | Claiming that the 'descent chain' is a logical derivation without gaps. | Claiming that the bridge between theology and science is a settled derivation rather than a hypothesis.
kill_conditions: If a fifth hidden axiom is found in the parallel track. | If a derivation step in the A-sheets is broken. | If the mapping of the four debts to the Trinity is shown to be incoherent.
lean_target: The document should be treated as a theological axiom and a philosophical proposal, not as a formal proof. The parallel track (A-sheets) should be evaluated independently for logical validity.
plain_summary: This document proposes that all inquiry rests on four unprovable assumptions: existence, distinction, relation, and orientation. It argues that these four debts can be paid by a single axiom: the Trinitarian God. It also provides a parallel track that treats the four as brute axioms without theology. The document is a theological and philosophical framework, not a formal proof. It explicitly warns against overclaiming its status.
